name: fiorne-stacks
summary: Fiorne's Bunny Stacks start even inside a protected base: her stack ability ignores the input lock (ShouldIgnoreInputLock), like the item actives that must run while abilities are locked

assets.why: Her stack system is started once, when her passive grants it, and the game's activation check refuses any ability whose hero has Systems.Input.LockAbilities unless the ability sets ShouldIgnoreInputLock. Base protection (base blockers) grants that lock in the base, so a start that came while she was protected never happened and nothing retried it: 0 stacks all match, Space unusable. The flag is copied from Cleanse's defaults (true there).
